blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Autonomous mobility is essential for sustained lunar surface operations, as communication delays and line-of-sight occlusions limit continuous teleoperation. Although recent traversability estimation methods increasingly rely on deep learning, the domain gap between terrestrial analogue environments and real lunar terrain can limit their generalisation, and real lunar traversability labels are scarce, making fully supervised training difficult. To address these challenges, we build a weakly supervised framework trained on sparse pairwise annotations and study whether augmenting visual features with depth-derived geometric information: depth, surface normals, and combined geometric descriptors. We evaluate the models in both in-domain and cross-domain settings using two terrestrial analogue datasets and the real lunar Chang'E PCAM dataset. Contrary to expectations, we find that naive geometric augmentation yields no consistent improvement over a strong visual-only baseline in either setting, with effects small relative to seed-to-seed variance. Instead, the choice of training source emerges as the dominant factor in transfer quality: models trained on domain-relevant sources transfer substantially better to real lunar imagery than the geometric fusion strategy improves any single model. Our evaluation runs onboard a resource-constrained edge device and provides a controlled baseline for designing more expressive multimodal fusion architectures in future lunar perception systems.
blocks.zh: 自主移动对于持续的月球地表操作至关重要,因为通信延迟和视线堵塞限制了连续的远程操作. 虽然最近的可转性估计方法越来越依赖深度学习,但陆地模拟环境与真实月球地形之间的域位差距可以限制其通缩,而真实的月球可转性标签也很少,使得完全监督的培训变得困难. 为了应付这些挑战,我们建立了一个受到薄弱监督的框架,经过培训后,只有稀少的对称说明,并研究是否增加了带有深度几何信息的视觉特征:深度、地表常态和综合几何描述符。 我们利用两个地面模拟数据集和真正的月球常平ECAM数据集,对域内和跨域设置中的模型进行评估. 与预期相反,我们发现,天真几何增生在两种情况下都无法比强的仅可视基线得到持续改善,其影响相对于种子到种子的差异较小。 相反,选择培训来源是转让质量的主导因素:接受过域相关来源培训的模型比几何聚变战略改进任何单一模型要好得多地转移到真实的月球图像上。 我们的评价运行在资源受限制的边缘装置上,为未来月球感知系统中设计更能表达式的多模式聚变架构提供了可控基线.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Autonomous mobility is required for long-term lunar surface operations. Communication latency and frequent line-of-sight occlusions limit continuous teleoperation, so a rover must judge for itself whether the terrain ahead is safe to cross. Regardless of the rover’s mode of operation – whether it operates autonomously or is controlled remotely – terrain traversability estimation can increase movement speed and reduce hazardous situations. Recent traversability methods increasingly build on learned visual features, and self-supervised foundation models such as DINOv2 [ 1 ] produce dense descriptors that transfer across domains far better than encoders trained from scratch [ 2 ] . Lunar imagery, however, is strongly out-of-distribution: illumination is harsh and unfiltered, and surface albedo and regolith texture differ from terrestrial simulants and between analogue facilities. Even foundation features, therefore, retain a residual domain gap, and how well they transfer to traversability across lunar datasets is seldom measured [ 3 ] . Although the traversability investigated in this work has no physical reference, it provides semantic understanding of unstructured terrain, increasing the rover’s ability to distinguish safe from hazardous regions based on visual appearance alone.
blocks.zh: 长期月球表面操作需要自主机动. 通信延迟和频繁的视线隔离限制了连续的远程操作,因此一个漫游者必须自行判断前面的地形是否安全地穿过. 无论Rover的操作模式如何 -- -- 无论是自主操作还是遥控操作 -- -- 地形可移动性估计可以提高移动速度并减少危险情况。 最近的可转换性方法日益以所学的视觉特征为基础,自控的基础模型,如DINOv2[1]产生密集的描述符,比从零开始训练的编码器更能跨域传输. [2]. 然而,月光成像强烈出自分泌:发光性严酷而未被过滤出,表面反照率和Regolith纹理与陆生兴奋剂以及模拟设施不同. 因此,即使是地基特征也保留了剩余域间隙,并且很少测量它们如何在月球数据集之间转换。 虽然在这项工作中调查的可移动性没有物理参考,但它提供了对无结构地貌的语义理解,提高了漫游者仅凭视觉外观就与危险区域区分的能力.

blocks.en: Fig. 1 : The same real lunar scene (Chang’E PCAM) shown as visual, surface normals, and predicted traversability. Photometric appearance shifts markedly across domains, while the geometry governing traversability is largely preserved, motivating depth-derived inputs for cross-dataset transfer.
blocks.zh: 图一:以视觉,地表常态,预测可转性显示的同名正月球场景(Chang'E PCAM). 光度外观在各领域之间明显变化,而关于可变性的几何学则基本保留下来,激发了跨数据集传输的深度输入。

blocks.en: Recent weakly supervised approaches estimate traversability by extracting dense per-pixel descriptors through FeatUp upsampling of DINO features and ranking terrain traversability using a lightweight MLP that operates on visual imagery alone. We hypothesise that augmenting these visual representations with explicit geometric information – namely depth, surface normals, and handcrafted geometric features – can further reduce the remaining cross-domain gap. Unlike photometric cues, which vary with illumination conditions and sensor characteristics, the physical determinants of traversability, such as slope, surface roughness, and the geometry of rocks and crater rims, remain largely invariant across domains (Figure 1 ). Building on this paradigm, we extend visual feature-based traversability estimation by integrating upsampled DINO descriptors with geometric channels. We train the resulting model within the weakly supervised W-RIZZ approach [ 4 ] and evaluate it using the Human Disagreement Rate (HDR).
blocks.zh: 近期监管不力的方法通过FeatUp对DINO特征进行检测并使用仅以可视图像操作的轻量级MLP来提取密集的每像素描述符来估计地形可移动性。 我们假设,用明确的几何信息——即深度、地表常态和手工制成的几何特征——来增加这些视觉表现,可以进一步缩小剩余的跨域差距。 与光度测量提示因发光条件和传感器特征而异不同,可变性的物理决定因素,如坡度,地表粗糙度,岩石和陨坑边缘的几何特征,在域相差很大(图1). 在这个范式的基础上,我们通过将被取样的DINO描述符与几何通道相融合,扩展了基于视觉特征的可变性估计. 我们通过监督不力的W-RIZZ方法来培训由此产生的模式,并使用人类分歧率(HDR)进行评估。

blocks.en: Our specific contributions are:
blocks.zh: 我们的具体贡献是:

blocks.en: • an adaptation of CHUNGUS (Continual Human Understanding for Navigational Guidance in Unstructured settings) [ 2 ] with geometry-augmented inputs – depth, surface normals, and handcrafted terrain descriptors; • a cross-dataset evaluation protocol spanning two lunar analogue facilities (LunaPolaris [ 5 ] and our in-house OTRK Kąkolewo) and real lunar imagery from the Chang’E-3/4 panoramic cameras [ 6 , 7 ] , reporting all train–test domain pairs; • feasibility of the method working on an edge device.

blocks.en: II Related works
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: The literature generally categorises traversability methods into 3 main scopes: geometry-based, vision-based and fusion-based. Geometry-based approaches mostly rely on using exteroceptive sensors such as LIDAR and depth cameras. Firstly applied techniques were computationally lightweight and straightforward to implement, however, they often lacked robustness and struggled to adapt to unstructured, rough terrains. Advancements in machine learning and deep neural networks encouraged researchers to estimate traversability from point clouds by applying machine learning techniques [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] . Nevertheless, relying exclusively on geospatial data presents significant disadvantages as it ignores semantic properties of the terrain – such as distinguishing between solid bedrock and highly compressible sand. Additionally, the high cost and computational demands of LiDAR-based algorithms led to the development of vision-based methods. These approaches used various architectures, e.g., AlexNet or PSPNet, and applied different training methods, such as contrastive, self-supervised, or supervised learning [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] . As vision-based methods relied solely on visual appearances, fusion-based methods were subsequently developed to incorporate multiple sensory modalities, creating more robust traversability representations. One of the methods developed using multi-modal fusion and tested for space environments is Terrain Traversability Analysis using Geometry and Environmental Perception (TTA-GEP) for planetary rover path planning. The TTA-GEP system architecture operates on highly parallelised dual-stream processing, merging metric data with general object knowledge into one cohesive whole. The geometric stream uses stereovision to generate point clouds, which are processed into a 2.5D map that can be used to extract traditional geometric features such as slope or terrain roughness. Simultaneously, a powerful terrain classifier based on deep learning architecture processes images in order to semantically segment the environment. The goal is to accurately classify every segment of the Martian or lunar landscape. Semantic labels applied in TTA-GEP research divide the environment into categories highly specific to planetary robotics: bearing soil, exposed bedrock, fine sand, loose rocks, crater edges and ridges, hazardous depressions, and sky background. The last part is the continuous evaluation function, which mathematically fuses and weighs on-the-fly the cost derived from local terrain geometry with the discrete material label derived from semantic segmentation [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 文献一般将可变性方法归为3个主要范围:以几何为主,以视觉为主和以聚变为主. 基于几何学的方法大多依赖于使用LIDAR和深度相机等外观传感器. 首先应用的技术在计算上轻而易举地实施,但它们往往缺乏坚固性,难以适应结构不整齐的粗糙地貌。 机器学习和深层神经网络的进步鼓励研究人员通过应用机器学习技术来估计从点云的可变性[8,9,10]. 尽管如此,完全依靠地理空间数据也具有重大缺点,因为它忽略了地形的语义特性——例如区分固体地基和高度可压缩的沙地。 此外,基于LiDAR的算法的高成本和计算需求也导致了基于视觉的方法的发展. 这些方法使用了各种架构,如AlexNet或PSPNet, 并采用了不同的培训方法,如对比性、自我监督或监督学习[11、12、13]。 由于以视觉为基础的方法完全依靠视觉外观,因此后来开发出以聚变为基础的方法,以纳入多种感官模式,形成更强的可变性表现. 利用多模式聚变和空间环境测试而开发的方法之一是利用几何和环境感知(TTA-GEP)进行地平线转移性分析,用于行星漫游路径规划。 TTA-GEP系统架构以高度平行的双流处理方式运作,将公制数据与一般对象知识合并为一个整体. 几何流利用立体视觉来生成点云,这些点云被加工成2.5D地图,可以用来提取出传统的几何特征,如坡度或地形粗糙等. 同时,一个基于深层学习架构的强大地貌分类器会处理图像,以便分解环境。 目标是准确分出火星地貌或月球地貌的每个地段. 在TTA-GEP研究中应用的语义标签将环境分为行星机器人高度特有的类别:承接土壤,被暴露的基岩,细砂,松散的岩石,陨坑边缘和山脊,有危险的低气压和天空背景. 最后一个部分是连续评价功能,该功能在数学上将从地平面几何学得到的成本与从语义分解得到的离散材料标签相接并自上而下地重 [14].

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: Our traversability algorithm is based on the approach presented in the article “Do You Know the Way? Human-in-the-Loop Understanding for Fast Traversability Estimation in Mobile Robotics” [ 2 ] . The original method (called CHUNGUS) combines a self-supervised visual backbone with a lightweight prediction head to estimate terrain traversability from sparse human annotations [ 4 ] . It uses a pre-trained DINO model to extract general visual features from RGB images. FeatUp upsamples these embeddings, then passes them to a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP) network that predicts terrain traversability. In our method, we concatenate geometric features directly to the DINOv2 embedding vector as raw values, yielding a (384 + d)-dimensional input to the MLP head. We choose this naive fusion strategy to preserve the frozen backbone’s feature space without retraining and to evaluate the contribution of geometric cues while minimising changes to the network architecture and their influence compared to the visual-only baseline. More sophisticated fusion mechanisms, such as cross-attention or learned gating, are left for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们的可逆性算法是基于“你知道路吗? 人类在移动机器人学中快速可移动性估计的环行理解” [2]. 最初的方法(被称作"CHUNGUS")结合了自控的视觉骨干和轻量级预测头来从人类的稀有说明来估计地形可变性[4]. 它使用预先训练的DINO模型从RGB图像中取出一般视觉特征. 费特 这些嵌入物的上行样本,然后传递到轻量级多层受体(MLP)网络上,预测地势可转性. 在我们的方法中,我们直接将几何特征与 DINov2 嵌入向量作为原始值,向 MLP 头产生一个(384 + d)维的输入. 我们选择这种天真的融合策略是为了保留被冻结的骨干特征空间而不进行再培训,并评估几何提示的贡献,同时将网络结构的变化及其影响与仅可视基线相比最小化。 更复杂的聚变机制,如交叉注意或学习的地标,留待未来工作处理.

blocks.en: We train the model using sparse pairwise annotations. Instead of assigning absolute values, a human annotator selects two points and specifies their relative traversability (less traversable, more traversable or equally traversable) – see labelling process details in Section IV-A .
blocks.zh: 我们用稀疏的双向说明来训练模型。 人类注释家没有指定绝对值,而是选择了两个点,并指定了它们的相对可变性(没有可变性、更可变性或等同可变性) — — 参见第四节A分节中的标签过程细节。

blocks.en: The original framework included a Human-In-The-Loop (HITL) component that required additional annotations when the robot encountered unfamiliar terrain during online operation. Since we evaluate geometric features’ influence in offline behaviour, we removed the human-in-the-loop component to preserve a fair comparison. The model trains entirely offline, simplifying deployment on edge devices. Compared to the original approach, we also replaced FeatUp [ 15 ] with AnyUp [ 16 ] because it better preserves semantic consistency, aligns spatial features more sharply during upsampling, and is more compatible with modern deployment libraries.
blocks.zh: 最初的框架包括一个Human-In-The-Loop(HITL)组件,当机器人在在线操作中遇到不熟悉的地形时,需要附加说明. 由于我们评价几何特征对离线行为的影响,我们移除了人行走的成分,以保持公平的比较。 模型列车完全下线,简化了边缘装置的部署. 与最初的方法相比,我们还用AnyUp [16] 取代了 FeatUp [15] ,因为它更能保持语义一致性,更能使空间特征在采样过程中更清晰地相协调,更能与现代部署库相兼容.

blocks.en: III-A Geometric information
blocks.zh: 三-A 几何信息

blocks.zh: 为了评估深度视觉特征和几何信息的综合情况,考虑了三个深度表述:

blocks.en: • Depth - DINO features are concatenated with a depth channel normalised to the [0,1] range. • Normals - Added 3 channels (x, y, z) encoding local surface orientation, capturing slope and discontinuities. • Geometric - In addition to the surface normals, three supplementary terrain descriptors were incorporated: – Slope magnitude: ( ∂ x d ) 2 + ( ∂ y d ) 2 \sqrt{(\partial_{x}d)^{2}+(\partial_{y}d)^{2}} , which quantifies the local steepness. Here, d d denotes the local depth value, while ∂ x d \partial_{x}d and ∂ y d \partial_{y}d are the partial derivatives (gradients) of the depth in the x x and y y directions, respectively. – Local roughness: depth standard deviation in a ( 5 × 5 5\times 5 ) neighbourhood (denoted as σ \sigma ). – Z-Score anomaly: ( z = ( d − μ ) / σ z=(d-\mu)/\sigma ), used to identify local depth outliers, where z z is the resulting anomaly score, d d is the depth at the point of interest, μ \mu is the mean depth of the surrounding local neighbourhood, and σ \sigma is the standard deviation of the depths within that same neighbourhood. These additional geometric features are concatenated with the upsampled DINO feature embeddings for every pixel before passing them to MLP. This combined representation allows the network to leverage both semantic and geometric features.

blocks.en: III-B Implementation details
blocks.zh: 三-B 执行细节

blocks.en: Each depth image was processed independently. We filled invalid measurements, defined as non-positive or non-finite values, using Navier–Stokes inpainting with a radius of three pixels. We used the valid measurements to determine the 1st and 99th percentile bounds, then clipped the depth values to this range and min–max normalised them to approximately [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . A bilateral filter was subsequently applied. Each geometry channel was independently scaled per image to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . We applied no dataset-level mean or standard deviation normalisation to the depth or geometry channels. We normalised only the visual input using the ImageNet mean and standard deviation.
blocks.zh: 每个深度图像都是独立处理的. 我们填充了无效的测量值,定义为非正值或非无限值,使用Navier–Stokes 涂装,半径为 三像素. 我们用有效的测量来确定第1和第99个百分位界限,然后将深度值剪接到这个范围,然后将深度值调整到大约 [0, 1] [0, 1] 。 随后采用了双边过滤器。 每个几何通道每个图像被独立缩放为 [0, 1] [0, 1]. 我们对深度或几何通道没有应用数据集水平平均值或标准偏差正常化。 我们只使用ImageNet的平均值和标准偏差使视觉输入正常化。

blocks.en: For the in-domain experiments, we divided each dataset into training, validation, and test subsets using a 70/15/15 split. For the cross-domain experiments, we divided the source dataset into 70% training and 30% validation subsets, while reserving the full target-domain dataset exclusively for testing. We based early stopping and best-checkpoint selection solely on validation data from the source domain. We used no samples or evaluation results from the cross-domain test set during training, early stopping, or model selection.
blocks.zh: 对于域内实验,我们用70/15/15分法将每个数据集分为训练,验证,测试子集. 对于跨域实验,我们把源数据集分为70%的培训和30%的验证子集,同时将完整的目标域数据集专门保留用于测试. 我们的早期停止和最佳检查点选择 完全基于源域的验证数据 在训练、早期停止或模型选择期间,我们没有使用跨域测试的样本或评价结果。

blocks.en: To train the prediction head, we used a similar strategy to Schreiber et al. [ 4 ] , adopting L R ​ i ​ z ​ z L_{Rizz} loss and training on sparse annotations. We resize input images to 224×224 and process them with a pre-trained DINOv2 ViT-S/14 backbone to produce 384-dimensional feature embeddings. We used a fixed seed for reproducibility. Optimisation is performed with a learning rate of ( 3 × 10 − 3 3\times 10^{-3} ) and zero weight decay. We decay the learning rate by a factor of 0.5 every 75 epochs. Training runs for up to 200 epochs, with early stopping enabled and a patience of 75 epochs based on the validation metric, HDR@0.25.
blocks.zh: 为了训练预测头,我们采用了与施赖伯等类似的策略. [4],通过L R i z z L_{Rizz] 损失和训练 在稀有的说明。 我们把输入图像的大小调整到224×224,并用一个预先训练的DINOv2 ViT-S/14主干处理,以产生384维特性嵌入. 我们用固定的种子进行再生产 实现优化的学习速度为 (3×10−3 3\times 10×3}),零重衰减. 我们以每75个纪元0.5的系数来降低学习率。 培训为200个学期,早期停课是可行的,根据验证指标HDR@0.25,有75个学期的耐心。

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四. 试验

blocks.en: IV-A Datasets
blocks.zh: 数据集

blocks.en: For cross-dataset lunar traversability estimation, three datasets are used, covering two lunar analogue test facilities and real lunar imagery from rover missions:
blocks.zh: 在跨数据集月球可逆性估计方面,使用了三个数据集,涵盖两个月球模拟测试设施和由rover任务产生的真实月球图像:

blocks.en: • LunaPolaris [ 5 ] was collected in the LunaLab [ 17 ] with a small rover. This indoor lunar analogue facility provides controlled regolith-like terrain under repeatable lighting conditions. RGB images were collected using a ZED2 stereo camera. Because the authors provide synchronised left and right images for each timestamp, along with calibration data, we use standard stereo vision techniques to compute depth maps. Figure 2 shows that the data used were taken under both diffuse and harsh lighting conditions. • In-House dataset refers to our own analogue test facility at OTRK Kakolewo 1 1 1 http://otrk.put.poznan.pl/ , equipped with diverse rock formations and crater-like features designed to emulate visual characteristics of lunar surface morphology. We collected visual data and depth images using an Orbbec Femto Mega camera mounted on a mobile robot. The camera utilises an indirect Time-of-Flight approach, emitting continuously modulated light and computing depth from the phase shift between emitted and reflected signals, yielding dense depth maps; however, its performance degrades under strong ambient sunlight. We collected data across varied lighting conditions, including low light, full daylight, and low solar angles that produce strong shadows and lens flares. Figure 2 also shows that the data were gathered in both diffuse and harsh lighting conditions, similar to LunaPolaris. • CE’3/CE’4 . We use real lunar surface imagery captured by the panoramic cameras (PCAM) of the Chang’E-3 [ 6 ] and Chang’E-4 [ 7 ] missions, obtained via the Ground Research and Application System (GRAS) of the China Lunar Exploration Program [ 18 ] . The PCAM instruments aboard the Yutu and Yutu-2 rovers acquired ground-level colour images of the lunar surface in Mare Imbrium and the Von Kármán crater on the lunar farside, respectively. Although stereo image pairs are available for the panoramic cameras, they are not temporally aligned. Moreover, calibration data from the rover missions are not publicly available. Consequently, we had to make several assumptions for stereo reconstruction. First, we used the camera parameters reported in the datasheet [ 19 ] as an initial estimate. Second, to rectify unsynchronised image pairs, we applied a point-based alignment approach. Specifically, we detected keypoints using SuperPoint [ 20 ] and matched them with LightGlue [ 21 ] to estimate a transformation between image pairs, without considering real-time constraints. Third, to address appearance differences, we used the S2M2 method [ 22 ] , a global matching neural network, to compute disparity. Repeated size estimation experiments on the Chinese national flag visible on the lander yielded a consistent error of approximately 15%, which is acceptable given the absence of precise calibration.

RGB图像使用ZED2立体相机来采集. 因为作者为每个时间戳提供了同步的左相和右相,加上校正数据,我们使用标准的立体视觉技术来计算深度地图. 图2显示所使用的数据是在分散和严酷的照明条件下得出的。 • 室内数据集是指我们自己的模拟测试设施,位于OTRK Kakolewo 1 1 1 http://otrk.put.poznan.pl/,配备了多种岩层和坑状地貌,旨在模拟月球地表形态的视觉特征。 我们用安装在移动机器人上的Orbbec Femto Mega相机收集了视觉数据和深度图像。 相机采用间接的 " 时空 " 方法,从发射信号和反射信号之间的相位相移中不断放出调光并计算出深度,产生密集的深度图;然而,其性能在强烈的环境阳光下下降。 我们收集了各种照明条件的数据,包括光线低、全日照和太阳角度低,产生强烈的阴影和镜头耀斑。 图2还显示,数据是在分散和恶劣的照明条件下收集的,类似于LunaPolaris。 * CE-3/CE ' 4。 我们使用通过中国月球探索计划地面研究和应用系统(GRAS)获取的由Chang ' E-3 [6]和Chang ' E-4 [7]任务全景相机(PCAM)捕获的月球地表影像[18]. 在Yutu和Yutu-2号游轮上的PCAM仪器分别获得了Mare Imbrium月球表面和月球远侧Von Kármán陨石坑的地平面彩色图像。 虽然全景相机有立体图像对相机,但没有时间对齐. 此外,没有公开提供来自rover特派团的校正数据。 因此,我们不得不对立体重建作出若干假设。 首先,我们使用数据表[19]中报告的相机参数作为初步估计. 第二,为了纠正不同步的图像对,我们采用了以点为基础的对齐方法. 具体而言,我们用SuperPoint [20] 检测出关键点,并将其与LightGlue [21]相匹配,以估计图像对之间的变换,而不考虑实时约束. 第三,为了解决外观差异,我们使用了S2M2方法[22],即一个全球匹配神经网络,来计算差异. 在着陆器上可见的中国国旗上反复进行大小估计实验,得出了大约15%的一贯误差,由于缺乏精确校正,这是可以接受的.

blocks.en: For each dataset, manual annotations were prepared based on sparse pairwise comparisons following the W-RIZZ protocol [ 4 ] . For each image, an annotator labels one of the point pairs as more traversable , less traversable , or equally traversable . The process does not define levels of traversability; rather, it ranks them, defining a global relation between image pixels. We select labelling points arbitrarily, focusing on certain relations and uncommon cases. In addition, inter-image pairwise comparisons are included, which improve the consistency of predictions across different scenes [ 2 ] . A quantitative comparison of the datasets, along with their characteristics, is provided in Table I .
blocks.zh: 对于每个数据集,都根据W-RIZZ协议[4]之后的少量对等比较编写了人工说明. 对于每个图像,一个注释者将其中一对点标为更可穿行,更可穿行,或等同可穿行. 这一过程没有定义可转性的水平;相反,它将其排序,定义了图像像素之间的全球关系. 我们任意选择标签点,侧重于某些关系和不寻常的情况。 此外,还包含图像间对等比较,这提高了不同场景预测的一致性[2]. 数据集及其特征的定量比较见表一。

blocks.en: IV-B Metrics
blocks.zh: 四-B 计量

blocks.en: We adopt the Human Disagreement Rate (HDR) metric introduced in W-RIZZ [ 4 ] , which measures the fraction of annotated point pairs for which the model’s predicted ordinal relation disagrees with the human label, using a threshold t t on the predicted score difference. Unlike absolute measures like MSE, HDR evaluates the relative ranking of traversability between points, aligning with the weakly supervised pairwise annotation scheme and accommodating the intrinsic uncertainty in assigning traversability scores. We report HDR averaged over thresholds t ∈ [ 0.10 , 0.50 ] t\in[0.10,0.50] as the main metric, along with the standard deviation, with HDR at t = 0.25 t=0.25 for direct comparison with prior work. To reduce the influence of randomness, we ran all experiments 10 times with different seeds and report the mean and standard deviation.
blocks.zh: 我们采用W-RIZZ[4]中引入的人类分歧率(HDR)衡量标准, 与MSE这样的绝对措施不同,《人类发展报告》评价了各点之间可变性的相对排名,与受弱监督的对等注释方案保持一致,并顾及在分配可变分数方面的内在不确定性。 我们报告,HDR平均值在[0.10, 0.50]t的阈值以上,与标准偏差一起作为主要衡量标准,HDR值为t=0.25t=0.25,与以前的工作直接比较。 为了减少随机性的影响,我们用不同的种子运行了十次所有实验,并报告平均和标准的偏差.

blocks.en: IV-C Results
blocks.zh: 四-C 结果

blocks.en: IV-C 1 Quantitative
blocks.zh: 数量

blocks.en: TABLE II : Results of traversability evaluation among datasets, averaged over 10 random seeds.
blocks.zh: 表二: 经常预算 数据集间可变性评价的结果,平均超过10个随机种子。

blocks.en: Table II reports full numeric results of HDR@0.25 and average HDR across all train–test domain pairs and input modalities, while Figure 3 summarises the change in HDR@0.25 relative to the visual-only baseline across all train/test combinations and geometric fusion modes.
blocks.zh: 表二汇报了HDR@0.25的全部数字结果和所有列车测试域对和输入模式的平均HDR的结果,而图3则概括了HDR@0.25相对于所有列车/测试组合和几何聚变模式的只视觉基线的变化。

blocks.en: In in-domain settings, geometric fusion has a small effect throughout. For In-house → In-house \text{In-house}\rightarrow\text{In-house} , all three modes remain within one standard deviation of the visual baseline, with no mode showing a statistically distinguishable improvement. For LunaPolaris → LunaPolaris \text{LunaPolaris}\rightarrow\text{LunaPolaris} , Depth and Normals yield modest gains ( Δ \Delta HDR@0.25 of -0.005 and -0.006, respectively), while Geometric produces the largest improvement of the two in-domain cases (-0.006, HDR@0.25 0.040 vs 0.046 for Visual).
blocks.zh: 在域内设置中,几何聚变在整个过程中具有小的作用. 对于内部\\ 内部\ text{ 内部\ 右侧\ text{ 内部},所有三种模式都保持在视觉基线的一个标准偏差内, 没有模式显示在统计上可以区分的改进 。 对于LunaPolaris – LunaPolaris\text{LunaPolaris\rightarrow\text{LunaPolaris},深度和常态的增益不大(分别为-0.005和-0.006中的-\Delta HDR@0.25),而几何学对两个域内案例的改进最大(-0.006、HDR@0.25 0.040对视界的0.046)。

blocks.en: In cross-domain transfer, the results are inconsistent across both settings and modalities. The clearest benefit appears for In-house → LunaPolaris \text{In-house}\rightarrow\text{LunaPolaris} , where Depth reduces HDR@0.25 from 0.119 to 0.107 ( Δ \Delta = -0.012), the largest absolute improvement observed. For LunaPolaris → In-house \text{LunaPolaris}\rightarrow\text{In-house} , Geometric achieves the best result (0.072 vs. 0.075 for Visual, Δ \Delta = -0.003), while Depth and Normals slightly degrade performance. Transfer to CE-3/4 shows no consistent pattern: for In-house → CE-3/4 \text{In-house}\rightarrow\text{CE-3/4} , all modes perform within the noise of Visual, and for LunaPolaris + In-house → CE-3/4 \text{LunaPolaris}+\text{In-house}\rightarrow\text{CE-3/4} , Geometric is the worst-performing mode (0.124 vs 0.107 for Visual, Δ \Delta = +0.017), the only case where geometric fusion causes a clearly detrimental effect.
blocks.zh: 在跨域转移中,不同设置和模式的结果不一致. 最明显的好处出现在内部 – LunaPolaris\text{ in-house\rightarrow\text{LunaPolaris},其中深度将HDR@0.25从0.119降至0.107(\\Delta=-0.012),这是观察到的最大绝对改进. 对于LunaPolaris → 内部\text{LunaPolaris → rightarrow\text{ 内部},几何学取得了最佳效果(视觉学的0.072对0.075,\Delta = -0.003),而深度和正常学的性能则略有下降. 转到CE-3/4没有显示一致的模式:对于内部 → CE-3/4\text{在内部 → 右翼 →text{CE-3/4},所有模式都表现在视觉噪声范围内,对于LunaPolaris + 在内部 → CE-3/4\text{在内部 → LunaPolaris →text{在内部 → 右翼 →text{CE-3/4},几何是表现最差的模式(对于视觉来说是0.124 vs 6.107,\Delta = + 0.017),只有几何聚变才造成明显的不利影响.

blocks.en: Overall, no modality consistently outperforms the visual-only baseline across the evaluated settings. Where geometric fusion helps, the improvements are small relative to the seed-to-seed variance, and in the one case where it clearly changes the result – LunaPolaris + In-house → CE-3/4 \text{LunaPolaris}+\text{In-house}\rightarrow\text{CE-3/4} – the effect is detrimental. We therefore do not claim that geometric fusion improves traversability estimation under the naive concatenation strategy used here; rather, these results establish a controlled baseline against which more expressive multimodal architectures can be compared in future work.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,没有一种模式一贯地超过所评价环境的仅可视基线。 在几何聚变有所帮助的地方,相对于种子到种子的相差,改进是很小的,在其中一种情况下,它明显改变结果 — LunaPolaris + 内部 — CE-3/4\text{LunaPolaris}+\text{ in-house}\rightarrow\text{CE-3/4} — 效果是有害的。 因此,我们并不声称,根据此处采用的天真交配战略,几何聚变可以改善可变性估计;相反,这些结果确立了一个可控基线,在今后的工作中可以据此比较更为明确的多式联运结构。

blocks.en: We note that the apparent benefit of geometric augmentation is substantially smaller when averaged over multiple seeds than under a single training run: effects that appear sizeable in an individual run (exceeding 30% relative HDR reduction in some transfers) fall within seed-to-seed variance once averaged over 10 runs. This reinforces the importance of multi-seed evaluation when comparing closely-performing modalities.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,平均在多个种子上,几何增殖的明显好处远远小于一次训练下:每次训练中效果似乎相当大(超过《人类发展报告》中某些转让的30%),一旦超过10次训练,就属于种子对种子的差异。 这加强了在比较运作密切的方式时进行多种子评价的重要性。

blocks.en: Fig. 3 : Change in HDR@0.25 relative to the visual-only baseline for each geometric fusion mode (Depth, Normals, Geometric). Values below zero indicate improvement over the visual baseline; values above zero indicate degradation.

blocks.en: Fig. 4 : Qualitative traversability predictions across all train-test domain pairs. Traversability heatmaps: warmer colours indicate lower scores. Overall traversability: green - visual is more sensitive, purple - Depth is more sensitive.
blocks.zh: 图4:所有列车测试域对的定性可变性预测. 可转移性热图:更温暖的颜色表示分数较低. 整体可变性:绿色-视觉更敏感,紫色-深度更敏感.

blocks.en: Figure 4 provides qualitative traversability predictions for all train–test pairs. To further highlight the differences between prediction outputs, we provide an additional qualitative visualisation. Since the traversability score distributions differ across methods, we first discard the top and bottom 5% of prediction values for each method. We then compute the mean of the remaining values and use it as a threshold to separate traversable and non-traversable regions. We overlay the resulting contours on the original RGB image, with coloured regions indicating areas classified as non-traversable. Visual-only-based predictions are shown in green, while depth-based predictions are shown in purple. In in-domain settings (Figs. 4 a–b), both Visual and Depth heatmaps produce spatially coherent predictions that align well with annotated boundaries: flat regolith receives high traversability scores while rocks and crater features are correctly penalised. The differences are particularly visible in cross-domain evaluations on terrestrial analogue datasets. In some cases, the Visual model fails to capture subtle variations between terrain types, leading to uncertain or inconsistent predictions. For example, it may classify craters as highly traversable or flat surfaces as poorly traversable (Figs. 4 c–d). For cross-domain evaluation on real lunar data, the visual-based predictions are generally spatially plausible, but the depth-enhanced models produce more cohesive regions and show greater confidence in distinguishing traversable from non-traversable terrain (Figs. 4 e–g).
blocks.zh: 图4提供了所有火车测试对的定性可变性预测。 为了进一步突出预测产出之间的差异,我们提供了额外的定性可视化。 由于不同方法的可转性分数分布不同,我们首先放弃了每种方法的上下5%的预测值. 然后我们计算剩余数值的平均值,并将其作为一个界限,将可移动和不可移动的区域分开。 我们在原始的RGB图像上覆盖了由此形成的轮廓,有色区域表示被划为不可逆的区域. 仅以可视为主的预测以绿色显示,而以紫色显示以深度为主的预测. 在域内设置(图4 a-b)中,视觉和深度热图都产生空间上一致的预测,这些预测与附加说明的边界非常一致:平坦的Regolith得到高可变分数,而岩石和陨坑特征则受到正确的惩罚. 在地面模拟数据集的跨域评价中,差异尤其明显. 在某些情况下,Visual模型未能捕捉地形类型之间的微妙变化,导致预测不确定或不一致. 例如,它可能把陨坑归类为极易翻转或平坦地表为极难翻转地表(图4 c-d)。 就真实月球数据的跨域评价而言,基于视觉的预测一般在空间上是可行的,但深度增强的模型产生更相干的区域,并表现出更大的信心来区分可穿越地貌和不可穿越地貌(图4 e-g)。

blocks.en: IV-C 3 Edge Deployment Evaluation
blocks.zh: IV-C 3 边际部署评价

blocks.en: To assess edge deployment feasibility, we evaluated each model variant on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin (JetPack 6.2.2, L4T 36.5.0) using ONNX Runtime 1.22.0 with four execution configurations: CPU, CUDA, TensorRT FP32, and TensorRT FP16. Measured execution time included both model inference and modality-specific preprocessing (depth inpainting and geometric descriptor computation). Throughput was reported as mean ± standard deviation over 100 inferences, expressed in frames per second (FPS).
blocks.zh: 为了评估边缘部署的可行性,我们使用ONNX Runtime 1.22.0,在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin(JetPack 6.2.2,L4T 36.5.0)上评价了每个模型变体,并配有四个执行配置:CPU, CUDA, TensorRT FP32, TensorRT FP16. 测量的执行时间包括模型推论和特定模式的预处理(深度地印和几何描述计算)。 据报告,通过量平均为±标准偏差,大于100个推断值,以每秒框架表示。

blocks.en: Table III presents the throughput obtained for four model variants and four execution modes. CPU-only execution achieved approximately 0.21 0.21 – 0.22 0.22 FPS and was unsuitable for real-time operation. CUDA acceleration increased throughput to 13.7 13.7 – 17.1 17.1 FPS, while TensorRT produced between 18.7 18.7 and 29.1 29.1 FPS. The visual and depth variants reached almost 29 29 FPS with TensorRT, demonstrating the feasibility of near-real-time edge deployment.
blocks.zh: 表三列出四个模式变体和四个执行模式获得的吞吐量. CPU只执行约0.21 0.21–0.22 0.22 FPS,不适合实时运行. CUDA加速度将吞吐量提高到13.7 13.7 – 17.1 17.1 FPS,而TensorRT在18.7 18.7到29.1 29.1 FPS之间生产. 视觉和深度变体已与TensorRT相接至近29个FPS,证明了近实时边缘部署的可行性.

blocks.en: The differences between the TensorRT FP32 and FP16 configurations were small relative to the measured variability. FP16 achieved slightly higher mean throughput for the visual, depth, and normals variants, whereas FP32 was marginally faster for the Geometric variant. Therefore, reduced numerical precision did not consistently improve throughput, and you should also consider its effect on prediction quality when selecting the deployment configuration.
blocks.zh: TensorRT FP32和FP16配置的相差小于所测可变性. FP16的视觉、深度和常态变体的平均吞吐量略高,而FP32的几何变体略快。 因此,数字精度的降低并没有持续地提高吞吐量,在选择部署配置时,你还应考虑其对预测质量的影响。

blocks.en: The visual and depth variants obtained similar throughput because they require only basic preprocessing. Normals and Geometric achieved lower throughput because they must compute surface normals and additional terrain descriptors before inference. The results therefore show a trade-off between the information provided by geometric representations and the operating frequency of the full perception pipeline.
blocks.zh: 视觉和深度变体获得了相类似的吞吐量,因为它们只需要基本的预处理. 正常度和几何度都实现了较低的吞吐量,因为它们必须在推断前计算出地表正常度和额外的地形描述符. 因此,结果显示,几何表达方式提供的信息与全感管道的运行频率之间有取舍。

blocks.en: V Conclusions
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: We presented a cross-dataset evaluation of geometry-augmented DINOv2 features for lunar traversability estimation. Our method extends the weakly supervised CHUNGUS framework by concatenating depth-derived geometric channels – depth, surface normals, and handcrafted terrain descriptors – with AnyUp-upsampled DINOv2 embeddings before the traversability prediction head. Experiments across two analogue facilities and real Chang’E-3/4 lunar imagery show that, under this naive concatenation strategy, geometric augmentation has a negligible and inconsistent effect in both in-domain and cross-domain settings: where improvements occur, they are small relative to seed-to-seed variance, and in one cross-domain case geometric fusion is clearly detrimental. We therefore treat these results not as evidence that geometry improves traversability estimation, but as a controlled baseline that isolates the marginal contribution of geometric cues over a strong visual-only model and against which future work can compare more expressive multimodal fusion architectures. Independently of fusion mode, the choice of training source has a larger effect on transfer quality: LunaPolaris proves a more effective training base for real-lunar deployment than our In-House facility, consistent with the broader finding that domain relevance, rather than sensing modality, is the dominant factor in cross-domain traversability transfer.
blocks.zh: 我们为月球穿梭性估计提出了对几何特征的跨数据集评价。 我们的方法通过将深度、地表常态和手工绘制的地形描述符等深源几何道(AnyUp-upplamped DINOv2在可转性预测头前嵌入)来扩展受弱监督的CHUNGUS框架。 跨越两个模拟设施和真实的Chan ' E-3/4月球图像的实验表明,在这种天真接合策略下,几何增强在域内和跨域环境都具有可忽略的和不一致的效果:在出现改进的情况下,相对于种子到种子的相差小,在一个跨域情况下,几何聚变显然是有害的. 因此,我们不把这些结果视为几何学改进了可变性估计的证据,而是作为控制基线,将几何提示的边际贡献隔离于一个强大的唯能视觉的模型,而未来的工作可以以此来比较更具表现力的多式聚变结构。 独立于聚变模式,培训来源的选择对转移质量的影响更大: LunaPolaris证明,与我们的室内设施相比,实际月球部署的训练基地更为有效,这符合更广泛的结论,即域关联性而不是感知模式是跨域可转性转移的主导因素。

blocks.en: V-A Limitations
blocks.zh: 五-A 限制

blocks.en: The study has several limitations; we highlight two key issues. First, the handcrafted pairwise annotations were produced by a single annotator, which may introduce subjective bias and limit the assessment of traversability to the selected image regions and their visual characteristics. Second, the depth data across the evaluated datasets were obtained using different sensing modalities, including conventional stereo vision, deep learning-enhanced stereo vision, and indirect time-of-flight. Consequently, the observed generalisation of depth-based representations may partially reflect not only geometric invariance but also appearance normalisation introduced by the respective depth estimation pipelines.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有一些局限性;我们强调两个关键问题。 首先,手工制成的双相说明由单一的注释者制作,这可能会引入主观偏差,并将可转性评估限制在所选图像区域及其视觉特征. 第二,利用不同的感知方法,包括传统的立体视觉、深层学习增强的立体视觉和间接飞行时间,获得所评价数据集的深度数据。 因此,观察到的以深度为基础的表述的概括可能不仅部分反映了几何偏差,而且还反映了各自深度估计管道引入的外观正常化。

blocks.en: V-B Future work
blocks.zh: 维-B 今后的工作

blocks.en: Future work will extend the evaluation by examining model robustness under varying lighting conditions and systematically comparing alternative methods of incorporating geometric information into the model. We also plan to shift the focus of this research from algorithm-centric evaluation toward robot-centric validation. This includes integrating the proposed method with a path-planning algorithm and deploying it on a real rover in our in-house OTRK facility, where performance will be assessed using metrics such as trajectory length, obstacle avoidance, and power consumption. Another direction for future research is to investigate how visual traversability information can support teleoperation by analysing its impact on operator behaviour, navigation accuracy, and overall task performance.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将扩大评价范围,方法是审查不同照明条件下的模型稳健性,并系统比较将几何信息纳入模型的替代方法。 我们还计划把这项研究的重点从以算法为中心的评价转移到以机器人为中心的验证上。 这包括将拟议方法与路径规划算法相结合,并将其部署在我们内部的OTRK设施中,在那里将使用轨迹长度、避免障碍和电力消耗等衡量标准来评估性能。 未来研究的另一个方向是调查可视可变性信息如何通过分析其对操作者行为,导航精度,以及总体任务性能的影响来支持远程操作.
